name: weed-plugins
description: Weed's Claude Code harness - one repo, per-loop plugins

plugins.name: weed-harness
plugins.description: Shared loop runtime every weed loop plugin builds on - loop-report (live progress page, Orca artifact/tab delivery), model-routing (model/effort tiers), loop-gates (unlazy completion discipline) - plus the Claude Code HUD and opt-in hooks

plugins.name: matt-loop
plugins.description: Matt loop - matt-auto, PR babysitting, and conflict resolution with automatic model/effort routing on Codex, OpenCode, and Claude Code, plus vendored Matt Pocock skills. Requires weed-harness 3.1+ for the shared progress page, routing table, and gates

plugins.name: auto-loop
plugins.description: Autonomous loop - autocode (hypothesis-driven parallel code improvement) with a live experiment board. Requires weed-harness 3.1+ for the shared progress page, routing table, and gates
